# ReplyGenie

> AI reply coach that crafts the perfect response to any message, chat, or screenshot — choose your tone and get four ready-to-send replies with clear reasoning.

ReplyGenie helps you decide what to reply. Paste a message you received, pick the tone you want (romantic, bold, cold, smart, or firm), and get four AI-crafted response variants along with a short read of the sender's intent so you know why each reply works before you send it.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Paste a message and get AI-crafted reply options in your chosen tone.
- [AI Reply Generator](/ai-reply-generator): How the reply generator works, use cases, and FAQ.
- [How to Reply](/how-to-reply): Twelve real situations with the read behind them and example wording.
- [Tactics guide](/tactics-guide): Learn common manipulation tactics and how to reply to them.
- [History & Privacy](/history): Your saved replies and how we handle your data.
